properties.headline: High Surf Advisory issued October 30 at 3:16AM ChST until October 31 at 4:00PM ChST by NWS Tiyan GU
properties.description:
* WHAT...Large breaking waves of 10 to 14 feet and dangerous rip
currents expected.

* WHERE...North and east facing reefs of Guam and Rota.

* WHEN...From 2 AM Friday to 4 PM ChST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Dangerous swimming and surfing conditions and
localized beach erosion. Rip currents can sweep even the best
swimmers away from shore into deeper water.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...As TY In-fa moves west-northwest toward the
far northern CNMI, seas are expected to rapidly increase due to
the large, long-period northeast swell emanating from In-fa.
This has begun to produce hazardous surf along north- and east-
facing reefs. As In-fa progresses, swell will become north, then
northwest, resulting in surf building over west facing reefs
Friday night. Surf will remain hazardous through at least
Saturday afternoon. These surf conditions will maintain a high
risk of dangerous rip currents.
properties.instruction:
Rip currents will be life threatening. Inexperienced swimmers
should remain out of the water due to dangerous surf conditions.

Rip currents will be life threatening. If caught in a rip
current, relax and float. Don't swim against the current. If
able, swim in a direction following the shoreline. If unable to
escape, face the shore and call or wave for help.
